versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json. pageSpecVersion is pinned by the schema (const) and used by the adversarial controls, but nothing compares this manifest field to it. repositoryVersion, and the catalogVersion/policyVersion fields inside tokens/llm/, are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers. The token catalog itself is machine-checked by content (rebuilt and compared), not by version.

modes.generation: default; new pages for the AI team (RAG/Remix). Generation-safe asset roles only, token references only, no real Cradle brand/customer/person content.
modes.clone: opt-in with "mode": "clone"; exact reproduction of the local clone for fidelity QA only.

source.description: Local React/Vite replica of the public Cradle marketing site (www.cradle.bio), measured 2026-10-12
